_comment_synthesize: Tape source. null/absent = AUTO-DETECT per symbol (recommended): uses the broker's real times&trades (flags + real volume) when COPY_TICKS_TRADE has usable prints, else synthesizes from quote ticks (last vs bid/ask, mid tick test; volume-weighted when the tick carries volume, else count=1/tick). true = FORCE synthesis; false = FORCE the real tape. Run diag_forces.py to see what your feed exposes.
_comment_liquidity: Day-outlook liquidity gauge: compares today's cumulative tick volume to the median of the prior N sessions at the same time-of-day, and pushes the ratio to the backend. baseline_days=0 or poll_seconds=0 disables it.
_comment_positions: Read-only mirror of your open positions for the live P&L / time-in-trade panel and in-trade alerts. Polled every positions_poll_seconds (0 disables). Reading positions never places orders.
_comment_allow_auto_close: EXECUTION GATE. false = strictly read-only (default). true = this collector WILL place closing orders when the backend's profit target fires OR you click 'fechar tudo' in the UI. Only set true on a machine/account where you accept automated order execution (test on DEMO first).
_comment_allow_auto_trade: OPENING gate for the explosion-scalper bot. false = bot can't open (default). true = bot may OPEN positions on bursts — but ONLY on a DEMO account (the collector refuses to open on a live account regardless). The bot ALSO needs allow_auto_close=true (it must be able to close to exit/stop), else the backend won't arm it. Separate flag because opening is far riskier than closing. Requires AutoTrading on in the MT5 terminal (Ctrl+E).
